reproduce.title: Separate Calculator evaluation time from slow global search plugins
reproduce.version_requirement: 0.102.3001 versus current stable/main with the supplied Run settings and current locale.
prerequisites: Use an isolated test account or controlled test machine; preserve existing user data.
steps: 1. Time 999*1.3 and 999*13 as global queries, then with the configured Calculator activation keyword (default '='); preserve normal plugin settings.
2. Repeat with Windows Indexer temporarily disabled only in the isolated test profile; compare per-plugin timings and time-to-first Calculator result.
3. Compare the locale's native decimal separator with English-format input using the existing Calculator option.
4. Document 999+30% behavior separately from the delay; confirm intended percentage semantics before any language change.
reproduce.expected_result: Simple Calculator results appear promptly even if another provider is slow; number-culture controls are correct, and unsupported percentage syntax is not misrepresented as a latency fix.
